quotes.text: Bug 1883855 added an Apple armored public-key fixture after RNP 0.17.1 fixed parsing of whitespace after its CRC line. The 2024 importer also called trim on every input. Bug 1921728 later found that this removed valid trailing bytes from binary keys. Current importToFFI tests for the armored BEGIN PGP marker, strips Comment lines only there, and does not trim binary data. Treat the import input as either text armor or byte data before normalization; cover both forms in tests. The 2024 trim pattern is obsolete.
